block_D.loss: mean squared Fischer-Burmeister residual of (saving share, 1 - beta R E[u'(c')]/u'(c)); expectation exact
block_D.network: 2 inputs (scaled log(1+a), scaled log e), two tanh layers of 32, sigmoid share of cash on hand
block_D.informed_start: 300 steps of least squares on the rule a' = a (consume income, keep assets); no classical policy
notes: share_at_limit_network is near zero by construction: a sigmoid share never reaches exactly zero, so compare share_near_limit (assets within near_limit_distance of the limit)
K_gap_per_unit_of_mean_policy_error is informative only when the mass-weighted signed gap is not close to zero (about 30 for the random start at the live budget)
held-out points: three between each pair of neighbouring grid nodes, every productivity state; Euler statistics use the points where the classical constraint is slack
euler_log10_mean is log10 of the mean error; euler_log10_mean_weighted is the mass-weighted mean of log10 errors, the statistic the classical checks report
block_D.timing_note: the seconds stored with each run were measured with the other runs in parallel on a shared machine
